domains.Account: The account area a student uses on the public website.
domains.Auth: Sign-in session upkeep on the public website: token refresh, logout.
domains.Cart: The student cart syncing between the browser and the server.
domains.ClassRequest: Logs emitted by the ClassRequest domain.
domains.Gdpr: Cookie and privacy consent captured in the browser.
domains.Legal: Legal document publishing and user consent acceptance.
domains.Media: Video and file storage, transcoding and secure playback.
domains.Payments: Student and academy payments: checkout, gateway callbacks, refunds.
domains.Quiz: A student taking a lesson quiz in the browser.
domains.RequestStorm: Client-side circuit breaker: one API route called far above human speed.
domains.SiteBlocks: Rendering an academy site's page sections.
domains.SiteCache: Logs emitted by the SiteCache domain.
domains.SitePreview: Preview rendering of an academy site template.
domains.SiteTheme: Loading an academy site's theme and template.
domains.Tutoring: Logs emitted by the Tutoring domain.

events.Account.AvatarCropFailed: Browser could not crop the picked avatar before upload.
events.Payments.SeatHoldExpired: The 10-minute seat hold ran out while the checkout dialog was open.
events.Payments.SeatHoldFailed: Holding seats at checkout open failed (class full or not on sale).
events.Quiz.DraftSaveFailed: Autosave of a student's in-progress quiz answers failed; the student keeps typing and sees an inline warning.
events.RequestStorm.Tripped: A single route exceeded the per-window hit limit in the student's browser; protected routes force a sign-out and storage wipe.
events.SiteTheme.UiTemplateFetchFailed: Site theme UI template fetch failed.
events.Tutoring.JoinClassFailed: Moving a 1:1 student into an open class failed.
events.Tutoring.JoinedClassFromPrivate: A paid 1:1 student moved into an open class from the classroom.
